result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but a likely missing header icon and awkwardly clipped horizontal carousel items make parts of the UI look broken.

issues.description: The circular control at the top right appears empty except for a small red notification dot, making it look like the profile/avatar or menu icon failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended avatar or icon inside the circle and keep the notification badge positioned at its upper-right edge.

issues.description: A nearly empty, partially visible category pill is clipped at the right edge of the category row.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or initial scroll position so the next pill shows enough content to be recognizable, or hide the overflow cleanly.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” row is heavily cut off, including its restaurant name and delivery information.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card widths and right-side padding, or expose a clearer horizontal-scroll affordance so the partial card looks intentional.
